description:
Ring cancelled its partnership with Flock, but ultimately this was an Amazon PR move. At the end of the day user footage can still be used by the police and ICE.

Video by: Trevor Hayes, Joseph Howard, and Court Fuller
title: Ring Cut Ties with Flock - But They're Still Spying on You. Here's How.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
New Brunswick, NJ halted the development of a data center last night. Hundreds of community members showed up, and organizers from across the region mobilized to pressure to the city council to do the right thing.

Community organizers packed the city council building, with hundreds more people outside. And the data center project that was moving towards approval was defeated.

The people were victorious, and outside they celebrated their win.

Video from @ben_dziobek
title: New Jersey Halts Data Center After Community Pushback
